description: This file contains functions and classes for managing plugins in the BORIS software, including loading, filtering data, and executing plugins written in Python or R. It also handles plugin metadata extraction and plugin execution workflows.

methods.name: add_plugins_to_menu
methods.description: Adds plugin actions to the plugins menu based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_plugin_name
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from a Python plugin file.

methods.name: get_r_plugin_name
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from an R plugin file.

methods.name: get_r_plugin_description
methods.description: Extracts the description of an R plugin from its file.

methods.name: load_plugins
methods.description: Loads plugins from specified directories, including Python and R plugins, and updates the analysis plugins configuration.

methods.name: plugin_df_filter
methods.description: Filters a DataFrame based on observations, subjects, behaviors, and time intervals.

methods.name: run_plugin
methods.description: Executes a specified plugin (Python or R) on the filtered data and displays results.
